# Chandra Ramanujan

> Product designer. Lead designer at Sitetracker; previously Wayground and Gojek.
> I think design decisions should be proven, not debated — so I prototype in code,
> run experiments, and let the data settle the argument. This site is hand-built
> static HTML/CSS, no JavaScript, no tracking. Case studies are ordered by strength,
> not chronology: a portfolio is an argument. Everything here traces to a shipped
> thing, a real number, or my own words — nothing invented.

## Start here

- [Home](https://chandraramanujan.com/index.html): The thesis and the work index.
- [About](https://chandraramanujan.com/about.html): The route from copywriting to research to product design, and how I work — writing as an operating system, publish at 80%, proof of work over claims.

## Work (case studies, strongest first)

- [Content moderation under political pressure](https://chandraramanujan.com/wayground-content-moderation.html): Sales wanted a kill switch for the content library under 'Parents Bill of Rights' laws; I fought for a granular moderation tool instead. Closed 3 red-state deals worth $400K. Wayground, 2025.
- [Do we ever need modes?](https://chandraramanujan.com/wayground-game-settings.html): Rebuilding the IA of Wayground's most-trafficked surface — twice. Shipped, watched it regress, diagnosed why, shipped again. The bug wasn't the IA; it was teacher confidence. Wayground, 2025.
- [Masthead ads: fighting for a seat at the table](https://chandraramanujan.com/gojek-masthead-ads.html): Writing our way into GoFood's redesign when the ads team wasn't invited, and building the platform's most successful premium ad format. Lifted merchant ROAS from 2x to 4.5x. Gojek, 2022–2024.
- [Banner CTR experiment: 60% uplift](https://chandraramanujan.com/gojek-banner-ctr.html): A multivariate experiment and automation workflow that lifted self-serve banner CTR by 60% for GoFood merchants. Gojek, 2024.
- [Usage analytics dashboard](https://chandraramanujan.com/wayground-usage-analytics.html): Scaling customer success from manual email reports to self-serve admin dashboards, designed around a hard Cassandra data-infrastructure constraint. Wayground, 2025.
- [Building Gojek's ads design system](https://chandraramanujan.com/gojek-ads-design-system.html): A unified component library and visual principles for all third-party advertising across Gojek, cutting new ad-format launch time from weeks to days. Gojek, 2021–2024.

## Essays

- [Why we banned "fortnite" but not "fortnight"](https://chandraramanujan.com/fortnite-vs-fortnight.html): Why a district moderation tool matches keywords by exact string instead of meaning — legible beat clever.
- [The ratings we didn't show](https://chandraramanujan.com/the-ratings-we-didnt-show.html): An experiment said hide bad restaurant ratings to lift clicks. Why the click-optimal move was the wrong one.
- [Why the moderation toggle is deliberately annoying](https://chandraramanujan.com/the-deliberately-annoying-toggle.html): When one person's careless click harms everyone downstream, adding friction is the user-centered move.
- [Copy-paste beats CSV](https://chandraramanujan.com/copy-paste-beats-csv.html): Cutting the obvious CSV upload and making admins type by hand — friction as a governor on search-wrecking volume.
- [Very smooth, very powerful](https://chandraramanujan.com/very-smooth-very-powerful.html): An ad-agency internship, a test drive I couldn't legally conduct, and how I figured out I was in the wrong room.
